items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: The next year, '52, I think it was Stan Kenton, who also had a great band at this time.

ctx.x: No, he (unintelligible). But it was the musical history. Duke Ellington and Nat Cole. So see, these things you can't relive. You know, I think about them and am grateful that I lived in this era that I could be a part of this, you know. The next year, '52, I think it was Stan Kenton, who also had a great band at this time. This was one of his great bands. Let's see, I think it was Bob Burgess, Buddy Childers, Don Bagby --
